profile: Mac Companion local XPC Interactive WebRTC negotiation v0.1
rules: only the exact authenticated and ready menu generation receives a command
the existing Interactive lease and WebRTC commands share the one-command-in-flight generation gate
offer and answer recheck the active Control lease, session, epoch, surface and revisions before and after every suspension
offer receipt SDP and fingerprint are bound to the exact command ID and fence
a remote-valid SDP larger than the local 4096-byte canonical payload bound is rejected before disclosure
close is idempotent only for its exact Control session; stale close cannot retire a replacement session
revocation, expiry, Stop, local peer loss or Agent generation loss closes peer and capture before old callbacks can present
no command carries pixels, input, a credential, a private key or an arbitrary diagnostic string
malformed, ambiguous, timed out, cancelled or cross-kind traffic ends the generation and Control fails closed
